nodes.name: Red Fields Survey
nodes.description: Set the rust-red dunes, quarry scarp, and dry basin on one page before a blade touches the claim.
nodes.effect: Banks the Red Fields authored-base survey family.

nodes.name: Ice-Quarry Tables
nodes.description: Count buried ice by depth, purity, and the melt-water each cut can honestly promise.
nodes.effect: Banks the quarry-ice and melt-water accounting family.

nodes.name: Basin Contours
nodes.description: Number the cuts, locks, and grades that will turn the dry basin toward a river.
nodes.effect: Banks the Dome Basin terrain-and-canal layout family.

nodes.name: Canal-Stage Ledger
nodes.description: Mark C1, C2, and C3 only when the defended gate and its earthwork settle together.
nodes.effect: Banks the serialized canal-stage and deterministic flood family.

nodes.name: Water-and-Green Record
nodes.description: Keep every wet cell and green shoot on the next page exactly where the last run left it.
nodes.effect: Banks the profile-persistent water-and-green tile-state family.

nodes.name: Storm-Draw
nodes.description: Lead a weather front into counted cells and let the old beam capacitors drink from the sky.
nodes.effect: Banks the weather-charged beam arsenal family.

nodes.name: Storm-Lance
nodes.description: Set a charged lens on the familiar watch footing and keep its path clear of every dome.

nodes.name: Storm Fence
nodes.description: Hold a tame crosswind along the claim edge so dust and devils learn one polite boundary.
nodes.effect: Banks the Storm Fence field-defense family.

nodes.name: Terraform Cannon
nodes.description: Throw one measured hillock where the survey calls for earth, never where the ledger calls it settled.
nodes.effect: Banks the bounded terrain-throwing arsenal family.

nodes.name: Old Digger Blueprint Science
nodes.description: A future Digger medal will release the boarding route, tape deck, and corrected canal diagrams.
nodes.effect: Banks THE OLD DIGGER blueprint science behind the reserved oldDiggerBlueprintCaptured medal flag.

nodes.name: Redfield Fittings
nodes.description: Grade regolith sleeves, dome ribs, valve brass, and dust seals under one shop standard.
nodes.effect: Banks the Red Fields fabrication-parts family.

nodes.name: Canal Gateworks
nodes.description: Fit each lock, dry wheel, and valve tower to the stage it must outlast.
nodes.effect: Banks the staged Canal Works fabrication family.

nodes.name: Weather Spire
nodes.description: Give every shepherded front a vane, a charge path, and a far row waiting for rain.

nodes.name: Seed Vaults
nodes.description: Keep E1 riverbank green by seed lot, wet reach, and the run that carried it outside.
nodes.effect: Banks the persistent green-economy and Seed Vault family.

nodes.name: Generation Ark Manifest
nodes.description: Enter every portrait, craft lineage, seed tin, and place at the Long Table before the ramps close.
nodes.effect: Banks the final Ark-yards stage and whole-town boarding manifest.
